integrity.claim_scope: Exact polarity process on full-dimensional parallelotopes from main-diagonal interior starts.
integrity.computational_role: Finite replay is corroborative only and not an infinite proof.
integrity.proof_basis: Analytic symmetry reduction, strict-concavity stationarity, exact center-map cancellation, and affine covariance.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns exact MinCE subproblems and main-diagonal starts only.
No claim is made for off-diagonal starts or finite-precision/inexact inner solves.
Originality searches cannot exclude every obscure or inaccessible historical source.
title: Main diagonals of every parallelotope are one-step center-identifying for the polarity process
